title: Scientists discover mysterious seahorse lookalikes that no one has ever seen alive
caption:
Meet the 'sea muppets.' These deep-sea fish were hiding in museum collections for decades, misidentified as seahorses until new technology revealed the truth.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover mysterious seahorse lookalikes that no one has ever seen alive

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261029072119.htm
